verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָ֖ד בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֕י לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הָיָה֙ בְּיַד־ חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ baš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš də·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh bə·yaḏ- ḥag·gay han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the twenty-first day . . . of the seventh month the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet saying

verses.original: אֱמָר־ נָ֗א אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־ שַׁלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַגָּד֑וֹל הַכֹּהֵ֣ן וְאֶל־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mār- nā ’el- zə·rub·bā·ḇel ben- šal·tî·’êl pa·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ben- yə·hō·w·ṣā·ḏāq hag·gā·ḏō·wl hak·kō·hên wə·’el- šə·’ê·rîṯ hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Speak . . . to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel governor of Judah and to Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest and also to the remnant of the people Ask them

verses.original: מִ֤י הַנִּשְׁאָ֔ר בָכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאָה֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַבַּ֣יִת הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן בִּכְבוֹד֖וֹ וּמָ֨ה רֹאִ֤ים אֹתוֹ֙ אַתֶּ֜ם עַ֔תָּה הֲל֥וֹא בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ כְּאַ֖יִן כָמֹ֛הוּ
verses.transliteration: mî han·niš·’ār ḇā·ḵem ’ă·šer rā·’āh ’eṯ- haz·zeh hab·ba·yiṯ hā·ri·šō·wn biḵ·ḇō·w·ḏōw ū·māh rō·’îm ’ō·ṯōw ’at·tem ‘at·tāh hă·lō·w bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem kə·’a·yin ḵā·mō·hū
verses.literal: Who is left among you who saw - this house in its former glory How does it look - to you now Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה חֲזַ֣ק זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֡ה וַחֲזַ֣ק יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַגָּד֜וֹל הַכֹּהֵ֨ן וַחֲזַ֨ק כָּל־ עַ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḥă·zaq zə·rub·bā·ḇel nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·ḥă·zaq yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ben- yə·hō·w·ṣā·ḏāq hag·gā·ḏō·wl hak·kō·hên wa·ḥă·zaq kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śū kî- ’ă·nî ’it·tə·ḵem nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: But now be strong O Zerubbabel declares the LORD Be strong O Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest And be strong all you people of the land declares the LORD Work For I am with you declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרַ֤תִּי אִתְּכֶם֙ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְרוּחִ֖י עֹמֶ֣דֶת בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם אַל־ תִּירָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- kā·rat·tî ’it·tə·ḵem bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·rū·ḥî ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem ’al- tî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: - This is the promise - I made to you when you came out of Egypt And My Spirit remains among you do not be afraid

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַר֙ אַחַ֖ת ע֥וֹד מְעַ֣ט הִ֑יא וַאֲנִ֗י מַרְעִישׁ֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־ הֶחָרָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar ’a·ḥaṯ ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ hî wa·’ă·nî mar·‘îš ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’eṯ- hay·yām wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says Once more in a little while . . . I will shake - the heavens - and the earth - the sea - and the dry land

verses.original: וְהִרְעַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֖אוּ חֶמְדַּ֣ת כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתִ֞י אֶת־ הַזֶּה֙ הַבַּ֤יִת כָּב֔וֹד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·‘aš·tî ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇā·’ū ḥem·daṯ kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ū·mil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- haz·zeh hab·ba·yiṯ kā·ḇō·wḏ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will shake - all the nations and they will come with all [their] treasures . . . . . . and I will fill - this house with glory says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: הַכֶּ֖סֶף לִ֥י הַזָּהָ֑ב וְלִ֣י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hak·ke·sep̄ lî haz·zā·hāḇ wə·lî nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The silver [is] Mine and the gold [is] Mine declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ כְּבוֹד֩ הַזֶּ֤ה הַבַּ֨יִת יִֽהְיֶ֡ה גָּד֣וֹל מִן־ הָ֣רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַזֶּה֙ וּבַמָּק֤וֹם אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn kə·ḇō·wḏ haz·zeh hab·ba·yiṯ yih·yeh gā·ḏō·wl min- hā·ri·šō·wn ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ haz·zeh ū·ḇam·mā·qō·wm ’et·tên šā·lō·wm nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former says the LORD of Hosts And in this place I will provide peace declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֙ לַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י שְׁתַּ֖יִם בִּשְׁנַ֥ת לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־ חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh lat·tə·šî·‘î šə·ta·yim biš·naṯ lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš də·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’el- ḥag·gay han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the twenty-fourth day . . . of the ninth [month] in the second year of Darius the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet saying

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אָמַ֖ר שְׁאַל־ נָ֧א אֶת־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים תּוֹרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar šə·’al- nā ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm tō·w·rāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Ask . . . - the priests for a ruling . . .

verses.original: הֵ֣ן׀ אִ֨ישׁ יִשָּׂא־ קֹ֜דֶשׁ בְּשַׂר־ בִּכְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗וֹ בִּ֠כְנָפוֹ אֶל־ וְנָגַ֣ע הַלֶּ֨חֶם וְאֶל־ הַנָּזִ֜יד וְאֶל־ הַיַּ֧יִן וְאֶל־ שֶׁ֛מֶן וְאֶל־ כָּל־ מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲיִקְדָּ֑שׁ לֹֽא׃ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים
verses.transliteration: hên ’îš yiś·śā- qō·ḏeš bə·śar- biḵ·nap̄ biḡ·ḏōw biḵ·nā·p̄ōw ’el- wə·nā·ḡa‘ hal·le·ḥem wə·’el- han·nā·zîḏ wə·’el- hay·ya·yin wə·’el- še·men wə·’el- kāl- ma·’ă·ḵāl hă·yiq·dāš lō way·yō·mə·rū way·ya·‘ă·nū hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment and it . . . touches bread . . . stew . . . wine . . . oil . . . or any other food does [that item] become holy No . . . replied the priests

verses.original: חַגַּ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ טְמֵא־ נֶ֛פֶשׁ יִגַּ֧ע בְּכָל־ אֵ֖לֶּה הֲיִטְמָ֑א יִטְמָֽא׃ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ
verses.transliteration: ḥag·gay way·yō·mer ’im- ṭə·mê- ne·p̄eš yig·ga‘ bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh hă·yiṭ·mā yiṭ·mā hak·kō·hă·nîm way·yō·mə·rū way·ya·‘ă·nū
verses.literal: So Haggai asked If [one who is] defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these does it become defiled Yes, it becomes defiled the priests . . . answered

verses.original: חַגַּ֜י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַיַּ֨עַן כֵּ֣ן הַ֠זֶּה הָֽעָם־ וְכֵן־ הַזֶּ֤ה הַגּ֨וֹי לְפָנַי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְכֵ֖ן כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ḥag·gay way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an kên haz·zeh hā·‘ām- wə·ḵên- haz·zeh hag·gō·w lə·p̄ā·nay nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·ḵên kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem wa·’ă·šer yaq·rî·ḇū šām ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: Then Haggai . . . replied So [it is] with this people [and] this nation before Me declares the LORD and so [it is] with every work of their hands whatever they offer there is defiled . . .

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ־ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם נָ֣א מִן־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם וָמָ֑עְלָה מִטֶּ֧רֶם אֶ֛בֶן שֽׂוּם־ אֶל־ אֶ֖בֶן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śî·mū- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem nā min- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm wā·mā·‘ə·lāh miṭ·ṭe·rem ’e·ḇen śūm- ’el- ’e·ḇen bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now vvv consider carefully from this day forward Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD

verses.original: מִֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בָּא֙ אֶל־ עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל־ הַיֶּ֗קֶב לַחְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mih·yō·w·ṯām bā ’el- ‘ă·rê·maṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘ă·śā·rāh bā ’el- hay·ye·qeḇ laḥ·śōp̄ ḥă·miš·šîm pū·rāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: from that time [when] one came expecting a heap of twenty [ephahs of grain] there were [but] ten When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty [baths] - there were [but] twenty

verses.original: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֑ם בַּשִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּבַיֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּבַבָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת וְאֵין־ אֶתְכֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·ḵem baš·šid·dā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇay·yê·rā·qō·wn ū·ḇab·bā·rāḏ ’êṯ wə·’ên- ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I struck you - all the work of your hands with blight mildew and hail - but you did not - turn to Me declares the LORD

verses.original: שִׂימוּ־ נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם וָמָ֑עְלָה לְמִן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה מִיּוֹם֩ לַתְּשִׁיעִ֗י הַיּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽיכַל־ יֻסַּ֥ד שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śî·mū- nā lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem min- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm wā·mā·‘ə·lāh lə·min- ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh mî·yō·wm lat·tə·šî·‘î hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh hê·ḵal- yus·saḏ śî·mū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: Consider carefully . . . . . . from this day forward from the twenty-fourth . . . day of the ninth [month] the day - the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid consider carefully . . .

verses.original: הַע֤וֹד הַזֶּ֙רַע֙ בַּמְּגוּרָ֔ה הַגֶּ֨פֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָ֧ה וְהָרִמּ֛וֹן הַזַּ֖יִת וְעֵ֥ץ לֹ֣א וְעַד־ נָשָׂ֑א מִן־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ō·wḏ haz·ze·ra‘ bam·mə·ḡū·rāh hag·ge·p̄en wə·hat·tə·’ê·nāh wə·hā·rim·mō·wn haz·za·yiṯ wə·‘êṣ lō wə·‘aḏ- nā·śā min- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm ’ă·ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Is there still seed in the barn The vine the fig the pomegranate and the olive tree have not yet yielded [fruit] But from this day on I will bless you

verses.original: שֵׁנִית֙ בְּעֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ וַיְהִ֨י אֶל־ חַגַּ֔י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šê·nîṯ bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- ḥag·gay lê·mōr
verses.literal: For the second time that day the twenty-fourth . . . day of the month the word of the LORD came to Haggai saying

verses.original: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל פַּֽחַת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י מַרְעִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- zə·rub·bā·ḇel pa·ḥaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr ’ă·nî mar·‘îš ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Tell . . . Zerubbabel governor of Judah [that] I am about to shake - the heavens - and the earth

verses.original: וְהָֽפַכְתִּי֙ מַמְלָכ֔וֹת כִּסֵּ֣א וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְהָפַכְתִּ֤י מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֶ֔יהָ סוּסִים֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֵיהֶ֔ם וְיָרְד֤וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·p̄aḵ·tî mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ kis·sê wə·hiš·maḏ·tî ḥō·zeq mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim wə·hā·p̄aḵ·tî mer·kā·ḇāh wə·rō·ḵə·ḇe·hā sū·sîm wə·rō·ḵə·ḇê·hem wə·yā·rə·ḏū ’îš bə·ḥe·reḇ ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations I will overturn chariots and their riders horses and their riders will fall each by the sword of his brother

verses.original: הַה֣וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֡וֹת אֶ֠קָּחֲךָ עַבְדִּי֙ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֤ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ כַּֽחוֹתָ֑ם כִּֽי־ בָחַ֔רְתִּי בְךָ֣ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm nə·’um- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’eq·qā·ḥă·ḵā ‘aḇ·dî zə·rub·bā·ḇel ben- šə·’al·tî·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·śam·tî·ḵā ka·ḥō·w·ṯām kî- ḇā·ḥar·tî ḇə·ḵā nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD of Hosts I will take you My servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel declares the LORD and I will make you like My signet ring for I have chosen you declares the LORD of Hosts
